story_theme_en: Lin observes angles in everyday objects. An open book has an angle of 90 degrees (right angle). A folded paper has an angle of 45 degrees (acute angle). A picture frame has an angle of 120 degrees (obtuse angle). Tell what type each angle is. And what is the sum of all three angles?
helper_tip: Right angle = 90 deg. Acute angle < 90 deg. Obtuse angle > 90 deg.
hint_th: มุมฉาก = 90° มุมแหลม < 90° มุมป้าน > 90°

steps.label: Step 1: Identify angle type

visual_blocks.title: Try It
visual_blocks.question: Which of the following are acute angles? 60 degrees, 90 degrees, 135 degrees, 45 degrees
visual_blocks.explanation: Acute angles are less than 90 degrees. So 60 and 45 are acute angles.

data.question: Which of the following are acute angles? 60 degrees, 90 degrees, 135 degrees, 45 degrees
data.explanation: Acute angles are less than 90 degrees. So 60 and 45 are acute angles.

worked_examples.question_en: 30 deg + 60 deg = how many deg? What type of angle is it?

common_mistakes: Forgetting that a right angle equals 90 degrees
hints: Remember: acute = small (< 90), obtuse = big (> 90), right = 90 exactly.

key_vocabulary.definition_en: An angle that is exactly 90 degrees
